authority: User $implement request; approved CW-15/C-AC-22; fresh shutdown identity review
objective: Require exact current RunIdentity before shutdown can report full termination complete, matching reconcile semantics.
required_changes: In every shutdown observation iteration, set terminated=true only for a RunObservation whose identity equals RunIdentity(record.task_id, record.revision, record.run_id) and whose fully_terminated is true.

Wrong-run, malformed/non-RunObservation, None and exception observations remain unconfirmed even when every recorded PID is dead; result complete=false with full_termination_unconfirmed. Preserve survivors reporting and bounded polling.

Prefer one shared exact-current termination predicate used by reconcile and shutdown if it reduces semantic drift without broad refactoring. Preserve repeated-shutdown at-most-once stop attempts, shutdown/action lock ordering and all takeover changes.
Add RED/GREEN tests for wrong task, revision, run ID, malformed/None/exception and correct identity, including all PIDs dead and repeated shutdown.
constraints: Surgical shutdown identity correction only. No other production/docs/workflow/PLAN/state, external/scripted OMP/reboot, full/live G3, dependency install, delegation, commit, publish, deploy or Docker. Use apply_patch/non-live tests.
report: Return candidate_ready/needs_reroute; exact observation identities/survivors/complete/problems/stop counts; regression totals/hashes/scope/residue/pending.
